title: LabMitra Medical Reference Library
notice: Educational reference only. User-provided workbook content has not been independently clinically reviewed. Not a diagnostic guideline.
workbookCaveats: Use the reporting laboratory's reference interval; ranges vary by method, age, sex, pregnancy and clinical context.
Do not diagnose from one value. Interpret results with symptoms, examination, timing, medicines and risk factors.
Test selection and interpretation must be clinician-directed.
